generator.name: hand-authored plan
generator.note: nothing is generated at load time; the document is the resolved result

notes.reach: Poppy Reach (11.6, wild, 28 phút, D3 C3, BIO-02): ngày u ám mềm (không nắng, trời phủ mây), anh túc đỏ tới chân trời trong cỏ xám-xanh — accent mạnh nhất của act; leo dần từ bến đê (Rook's Weir, nước đen dưới chân) lên đỉnh đồi Gentle House. Tường đá khô làm lối (cổng ruộng giữa hai trụ đá, stile, hẻm tường), nhà trại bỏ hoang mái sập một nửa (ba giường trống, mỗi giường một gối sạch), đống rơm, giá phơi anh túc, xe bò bỏ lại còn chăn đệm, miệng mỏ Flint Delvings trên gò phấn phía đông. Trên đỉnh: bậc lên đồi, tường vôi có hốc nến đứng yên, dãy ward với một cửa sổ ấm đứng yên (ảnh của act).
notes.smoke: Khói ngủ là địa hình (đề xuất LD): 5 vùng có viền rõ, tint ấm nhẹ, thở qua lại theo gió và đóng / mở lối (Z1, Z2 trên đường chính ở ruộng giữa, Z3 trên lối đông, Z4 ở ruộng dưới, Z5 trên đoạn cuối đường chính và lối cây gai). Đứng trong khói → chậm dần → ngủ thiếp (base map: chỉ đánh dấu). Bật/tắt, tốc độ trôi và nhãn ở mục "Khói ngủ".
notes.beats: Nhịp mở / hẹp dọc đường chính: cổng G1 → ruộng dưới (mở) → hẻm tường đá (hẹp) → sân trại (mở nhỏ) → stile S1 (hẹp) → ruộng giữa có khói (mở) → cổng G4 + hẻm trên (hẹp) → ruộng trên (mở) → bậc lên đồi (hẹp). Lát cắt nén nhịp còn 10–20 s mỗi đoạn; bản đầy đủ đề xuất 40–60 s (xem target).

code.note: sha256 of the listed lab source files at export time; labCommit = lookdev-lab HEAD; uncommitted = listed files that differ from HEAD (the export used the working tree)

coordinateSystem.system: three.js right-handed, Y up, metres. x = east, z = south (the default game camera looks north), y = height above the ground datum (water level 0 unless the map says otherwise).
coordinateSystem.yaw: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js Object3D.rotation.y (positive turns +z toward +x: a piece whose front is local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west).

heightfield.note: final ground height after base, hills, flattens, edge falloff, water beds, dikes and structure pads; bilinear sampling reproduces the lab ground

A08.1.name: Poppy drift clump
A08.1.reason: procedural: the lab draws it in code (poppyField)
A08.1.note: the field: ≈ 36 000 instanced clumps (6–8 stems, cupped red #B3262A heads, buds) in drifts with breathing room, swaying with the wind; the placed items mark the drift centres. Sheet clump ≈ 0.6 H tall, field clumps 0.42–0.82 m

A08.2.name: Drystone wall (module)
A08.2.note: GLB 3.2 × 0.84 × 0.96 m (keyed on the 3.2 m module it reads low: top 0.53–0.84 m, 0.96 m deep with the grass at its foot; its stone ends fall 0.02–0.19 m short of the box): every wall run is placed ×1.25 (4 m pieces, 1.05 m tall) at a 2.8 m module (3.5 m apart: the ragged ends overlap, no gaps); blocks on its stone core (0.6 × 1.25 = 0.75 m deep, the blockout was 0.7), the grass foot is walk-through; field walls make the lanes; on a slope each module stands on its lowest ground (stepped walls); also the round sheepfold. Base colour greyed and darkened to ~0.7 in the prep (prepare-act1-kit.py TINT, kit fix 10-23: the pale cream stone read near-white, the brightest thing in every view)

A08.2-stile.name: Squeeze stile in a drystone wall
A08.2-stile.reason: blockout: the lab draws a box shape (no model yet)
A08.2-stile.note: blockout kept (kit swap 10-23): the A08.2-stile GLB has no gap (its wall runs through, top 0.6–0.89 m with a dip to 0.61 m); the map needs a 1.8 m walkable gap with a worn sill and step stones (the walk grid passes, the wall stubs block)

A08.3.name: Abandoned hillside farmhouse
A08.3.reason: blockout: the lab draws a box shape (no model yet)
A08.3.note: blockout kept (kit swap 10-23): walls 2.7 m, ridge 5.4 m, chimney 6.4 m; the east half of the roof has fallen in (bare rafters) so the three empty beds show from above; the door (1.8 m) is walkable (the farm route goes in to V1). The A08.3 GLB is a closed house: its door is shut on the east gable, the roof whole, the inside a hollow shell with no floor; a roofless height cut would still leave no way in (and single-sided walls seen from inside), so the beat waits for a ruined-farmhouse model

A08.4.name: Hay rick
A08.4.note: GLB 3 × 3.2 × 3.6 m (round, a straw skirt makes it 3.6 m deep)

A08.5.name: Field gate between stone posts
A08.5.reason: blockout: the lab draws a box shape (no model yet)
A08.5.note: blockout kept (kit swap 10-23): the gates stand swung open into the field, 3.2 m between the posts (the lanes run through them); the A08.5 GLB's five-bar gate is shut across its posts (fine only off the lanes)

A08.6.name: Poppy-drying rack
A08.6.note: GLB 3.6 × 2.93 × 1.8 m (red poppy heads hang +z of the bar, a bench at 0.77 m), placed ×0.9 (3.2 × 2.6 m); replaces the kit tạm herb rack

A18.1.name: Abandoned ox cart with bedding
A18.1.note: GLB 2.3 × 1.85 × 4 m; shafts down, quilts, a straw mattress and one clean pillow — as if someone was carried away asleep (vignette)

A18.2.name: Farmhouse bed with one clean pillow
A18.2.note: GLB 1.57 × 0.98 × 2 m (drooping blanket); three in the farmhouse at ×0.85 (1.33 m wide: three fit side by side in the 3.8 m east half under the fallen roof), empty, each one clean pillow — Mercy's linen; one at ×1 dragged out into the poppies (unmarked vignette)

A18.3.name: Flint Delvings mine mouth (chalk-and-flint cut)
A18.3.note: GLB 4 × 2.69 × 3.77 m placed ×1.34 (5.4 × 3.6 × 5.0 m, lintel ≈ 2.9 m): a rock knoll with its own timber portal (the old mine-timber GLB is dropped); the portal is a painted recess, not a tunnel, so the whole knoll blocks (two crossed rects ≈ its round footprint); the plain back is turned into the chalk knoll; the side exit to the Flint Delvings (11.8) is a trigger at the face

A18.4.name: Hospice ward range (exterior)
A18.4.note: GLB 30 × 13.4 × 10.5 m (walls ±4.1 m, porches to ±5.3 m); brand-new whitewash, not one patch; one high window warm and still (Perfection light, on the model's own lit window, upper row): the act image, seen from the foot of the slope

A18.5.name: Hospice boundary wall with niche (still candle)
A18.5.note: GLB 6 × 2.95 × 0.85 m (end piers let the sections run on; plain whitewash back); every section has its niche and still candle — a row of identical still lights (Perfection grammar, glows on the model candles); the terrace edge, 2 m above the approach

A18.6.name: Hilltop approach steps
A18.6.note: GLB 4 × 2.61 × 4.06 m placed ×1.3 (5.2 × 3.4 × 5.3 m): seven clean treads up to a landing 1.8 m above the approach (the terrace is 0.2 m higher behind it); Play walks the hidden ramp `steps` through the step edges (STEPS_WALK), the terrain runs under every tread and the landing (STEPS_GROUND); the cheeks block, and so do the pillar bases and flower pots flanking the landing (GLB |x| ≥ 0.92, 0.4–1.3 m above it); potted red / cream flowers on the cheeks; the exit to the Gentle House

N-PR01.name: Abandoned reaping (sheaves, scythe, straw hat)
N-PR01.reason: blockout: the lab draws a box shape (no model yet)
N-PR01.note: rite 1: beside it a body-shaped hollow pressed into the poppies (field hole). Keeps the blockout: its GLB (act1-a23-1-abandoned-reaping) is a QA redo (the scythe juts out in mid-air with the jug hanging off it, no poppies, hollow sheaves)

N-PR02.name: Harvester's cairn with ribbons and a name slate
N-PR02.note: rite 2, under a drying rack in the farmyard. GLB 1.2 × 1.32 × 1.34 m (replaces the kit rock stand-in): the name slate leans on the front (+z), the ribbon stick on top (1.32 m); blocks as a whole

N-PR03.name: Shepherd's crook and folded coat
N-PR03.note: rite 3, inside the empty sheepfold (a ring of A08.2). GLB 0.74 × 1.6 × 0.79 m: the 1.6 m crook, the folded coat in front of it (+z); blocks on the crook only (0.3 × 0.3 m at GLB x −0.07…+0.23, z −0.27…+0.03: its shaft leans from (0.15, −0.09) 0.55 m up to (−0.02, −0.15) at 1.2 m, the hook reaches x +0.31 at 1.3–1.6 m; review a2x F-c), the coat stays walk-through

N-PR04.name: Lone hawthorn with ribbons (the ribbon thorn)
N-PR04.note: rite 4: wind-bent, ribbons tied in it, a sleeper's shoes beneath (A22.1); a landmark of the upper field. GLB 7.87 × 5.5 × 3.99 m: the trunk foot at (+0.27, +1.39) off the pivot, the crown swept to −x and back (−z) over a twisted trunk, the ribbon-rich side +z. Placed by its trunk foot on the rite marker and turned (yaw 200) so the crown leans east-south-east, downwind of the smoke (1, −0.15) like the blockout, seen from just right of its back by the game camera; blocks on the trunk only (its foot, and where it leans back at 0.8 m); ribbons and twigs walk-through

N-PR05.name: Straw doll on a stile step
N-PR05.note: unmarked vignette. GLB 0.3 × 0.32 × 0.33 m: the doll faces +z, its legs out 0.17 m in front of the pivot

A22.1.name: Worn shoes at the foot of the ribbon thorn
A22.1.note: rite 4: the sleeper's pair (the same model as the fens N-FN02), set beside the thorn's trunk foot, toes to the trunk
